head_commit.message:
Release pass: remove the review label of a released hold

Lead, 2026-10-24 (issue #56 stayed labelled after its release closed it): a
released hold no longer waits for review. After the merge or the close, the
release pass removes verification-needs-review. On later passes, an approved
item that is already closed as released (a merged PR, or an issue closed as
completed) loses the label too, so a failed removal is repaired. A 404 (the
label is already gone) is not an error. pr_submissions uses the same constant.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
